title: Crash on NS profile switch
body:
AAPS 2.8.2, Android 9 (Atom). Insight v3 with G6 (patched)

At 04:00 daily I run Autotune on a VM which backs up current profile, activates that backup via profile switch event and then runs AT to generate a new profile

When I wake up AAPS isn't running and I can see the backup profile was activated at 0401 and Loop wasn't running from that point (just pump basals active, no TT/TBRs/SMBs)

This has happened for 3 days now

I've disabled Play Protect in case that caused it and will report tomorrow with logs if still an issue
